_: ROUTE CENSUS — every path the application MOUNTS. APPEND-ONLY.
Not just the feature registry: the public legs (/login, /setup, /accept-invite,
/status-page) and /settings are routes too, and deleting one is the same loss.
Adding a route? Append its path. Retiring one? Do NOT delete the line: declare a
ROUTE_ALIASES entry in registry.tsx so the old URL still resolves. Deleting a line
here is how an operator's bookmark dies, and registry.route-conservation.test.ts
exists to make that impossible to do by accident.
Paths are the router's own ids with the pathless /app shell prefix removed.
